profile: The National Federation of the Agri-Food Industry (FENAGRI) was established in 1998 with the mission of bringing together professionals and companies from Morocco’s agri-food industry. It works to structure and unify the sector’s ecosystem and acts as a credible representative vis-à-vis institutional, financial, and public partners, both nationally and internationally. As the leading network of agri-food entrepreneurs in Morocco, FENAGRI brings together around fifteen professional federations and associations from the industrial downstream sector, as well as a broad network of agri-food companies operating across various value chains. Fenagri actively promotes the food processing sector at both national and international levels through a structured promotional action plan aimed at supporting Moroccan industrial operators. FENAGRI promotes sustainable socio-economic development of Morocco’s food industries, represents and defends the interests of local companies, and supports the development of agri-industrial exports and investment. It also actively encourages international partnerships and supports Moroccan companies in accessing global markets. Its activities are structured around six priority thematic committees: – Healthy and Safe Food – Human Resources Development – Upstream and Processing – Research, Development and Innovation – Foreign Trade – Environment, Sustainable Development and Climate Finance In its unifying role, FENAGRI is also leading the revival of the Technical Center for the Agri-Food Industry (CETIA) as a research, development and innovation hub, in close coordination with key sector stakeholders. On the occasion of ISM , FENAGRI has reserved a Moroccan Pavilion to showcase national expertise and support the participation of the following Moroccan companies: Magic Sweets International, Cahimsa, Best Biscuits Maroc, Ebbo Maroc, Ema Chocolate and Gaudium. Contact GHADAH AL NOUNO Export Strategy and Global Development Advisor Bayrouth 23, Boulevard Mohamed Abdou Quartier Palmier, 20340 Casablanca – Morocco Tel: +212 (0) 6 61 62 35 56 Email: pmo.export@fenagri.org Website: www.fenagri.org Gallery

profile: Koelnmesse GmbH - ISM Family Koelnmesse is an international market leader in organizing trade fairs for the global food and beverage industry. With the ISM Family – comprising ISM Ingredients, ISM Japan and ISM Middle East – Koelnmesse offers focused, internationally oriented trade fair formats for the confectionery and snack industry in key sales and growth markets. The trade fairs of the ISM Family stand for strong international relevance, in-depth market expertise and a clear focus on products, trends and trade structures within the industry. They provide efficient platforms for exchange, business development and international networking among manufacturers, brands, retailers and key decision-makers. With events in Europe, Asia and the Middle East, the ISM Family is present in major global markets. Through this international footprint, Koelnmesse delivers industry-specific trade fairs with regional focus and global reach, creating a strong foundation for sustainable international business relationships in the confectionery and snack sector.
